case.title: A location with no technicians shows only Unassigned in Tech View and Board View
case.custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner or Admin user whose role has Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit.
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 px wide, so the display switcher (List, Tech View, Board View) shows at the right of the Work Orders toolbar.
  • Location {Location-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Empty Shop") is used by this case only and has no technicians: no staff member has {Location-A} in their Location field. You are working at {Location-A}.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST F2 No Tech Location") has two Approved work orders at {Location-A}, {Work-order-1} and {Work-order-2} (for example S10043-17831 and S10043-17832), with no lead technician.
  • On the Work Orders page nothing is ticked in Status, Asset on Site shows no choice (if its chip shows Yes or No, click the x on the chip), Assigned to me is off and Search is empty.
case.custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders and click the All tab.
  2. Click Tech View in the display switcher.
  3. Read what the page shows.
  4. Click Board View in the display switcher.
  5. Read what the page shows.
case.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: Tech View shows the Unassigned group holding {Work-order-1} and {Work-order-2}, and no technician groups.
  • Step 5: Board View shows the Unassigned column holding {Work-order-1} and {Work-order-2}, and no technician columns.
  • Steps 3 and 5: both displays explain that there are no technicians. The PRD does not fix the wording: write down what you see (the design reads "No technicians yet" and "Add technicians to assign work orders. Until then, every work order stays in Unassigned."). A different wording alone is not a fail.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10045 (Story 2, Tech View — table grouped by lead technician); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 54 (15 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), Design updates required from Branko, S2-R2 and S3-R1, read 15 Oct 2026. The Design updates line was reworded in version 43 (8 Oct 2026); the no-technicians state is still listed as design work, so the expected results are unchanged. Claude Design export of 14 Oct 2026 (Work Orders.dc.html), no-technicians empty state. PRD footer comment Slavcho Mitrov 1 Oct 2026 item 3 (the panel explains work stays in Unassigned, no Add Technician button). Source-verified 15 October 2026. Last checked against build v26.40.19-72f4f3b (staging) on 10/16/2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • Design updates required from Branko: “Filtered-empty results (the List's empty state, S1-N1), and an organization with no technicians, in both new views.”
  • S2-R2: “Keep Unassigned, containing work orders without a lead technician, fixed before all technician groups.”
  • S3-R1: “Show one Board View column per eligible technician under S2-R7, plus Unassigned.”
  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, no-technicians empty state: “Add technicians to assign work orders. Until then, every work order stays in Unassigned.”

AUTOMATION: READY

changes.label: Preconditions
changes.old_value:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view (check in Settings > Roles & Permissions > open your role > Work Orders section). The Admin role has both.
  2. Use a desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  3. In the top bar, choose the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Create everything below in this location.
  4. Create a location with no technicians: Settings > Locations > add a location (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Empty Shop") > Save, and enrol only your own user there (Settings > Staff > your record > add the location; make sure your own record is not Clockable, or use a role that is Office).
  5. In the top bar switch to the new location and create two work orders there (Work Orders > New Work Order), e.g. S1-901 and S1-902. They have no lead technician.

  5. Click your initials at the top right > Change Location and pick the new location and create two work orders there (Work Orders > Create Work Order), e.g. S1-901 and S1-902. They have no lead technician.

changes.new_value:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 15 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011). A desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  • [User-A]: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  • A location used only by this case with no technicians in it: e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Empty Shop". No staff member has this location picked in their Location field (Settings > Staff), so no one counts as a technician there; you reach it with Change Location.
  • A person counts as a technician when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and the location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F2 No Tech Location" (used by this case only), with one contact and one asset.
  • Two work orders at the new location for that customer, [WO-1] and [WO-2], with no lead technician.

Setup

  1. Sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page (you appear as "Admin ShopView"). Check the location in the top bar next to the bell; to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  2. Create a location with no technicians: Settings > Locations > New Location > Name (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Empty Shop"), Address 1, City, State/Province, ZIP/Postal Code, Timezone and Telephone (all required; any test values) > Save & Close. The window notes "Setting up a new location may result in additional billing." Do not pick this location in anyone's Location field (Settings > Staff), so no one counts as a technician there.
  3. Click your initials at the top right > Change Location and pick the new location.
  4. Top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F2 No Tech Location" > Save (if it already exists, open it instead). On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, TRK-118) > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  5. Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F2 No Tech Location" and its asset > Save. The work order opens on its Lines tab with the New Line form open: in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; the build offers only ready-made lines), turn Line Approved on > Save & Close; the work order becomes Approved. Repeat for two work orders in all; record the numbers as [WO-1] (the expected results call it "S1-901") and [WO-2] (the expected results call it "S1-902"). They have no lead technician (numbers on this site look like "S10043-17581").
  6. Check the setup worked: the top bar next to the bell shows the new location; Work Orders > All tab lists [WO-1] and [WO-2] with an empty Lead Technician. If other work orders or a technician show at this location, use a fresh location.
